description: List the AI image, video, music, and sound-effect models available on BudgetPixel with base credit prices and capabilities. Featured models come first with a one-line role hint (when to pick each). Video models are priced per SECOND by resolution; music models are flat per track; sound effects are per second with a 3-second minimum. Prices are base rates — the user's plan discounts and free-model perks apply automatically when generating.
